decisions.reason: As a multi-model extension of the firm’s established office offer, the desk system fits core capabilities and likely stays unless it clearly falls short of aspiration levels.
A chair family is close to the firm’s established premium seating business, so with no clear evidence of failure management would likely keep it under normal organizational slack.
Floor cushions made from carpets are more peripheral and niche than the firm’s core furniture lines, so a modest performance shortfall would more likely trigger resource reallocation.
The designer-led upholstered sofa moved from mention to a dedicated page and sits squarely within the firm’s design and upholstery strengths, supporting continuation.
The high standing table complements the workplace portfolio and current flexibility trends, though its narrower niche makes it somewhat more vulnerable if results disappoint.
Although rugs are more distant from the historical offer, management framed this collection as a flagship direction, so strategic commitment and available slack favor keeping it for longer.
